reference_audit.rule: Expected labels were checked against the supplied evidence and v4 rubric; decisive arithmetic, suite balance, unit inventories, protected predicates, and denominator exclusions have deterministic tests.
reference_audit.truthful_omission_rule: The four auxiliary omission cases have material_error false and composite failure and do not enter rate denominators.
reference_audit.freshness: Identifiers, evidence records, numeric values, questions, and candidate answers are new to v8.
reference_audit.exclusion_basis: The amendment fixed 24 evidence compositions. These three drafted families were excluded before calls and are retained in the generator so they cannot be substituted after outcomes.

denominator_rule: Only accuracy_eligible=true cases enter composite, required-unit, core-field, false-rejection, and false-acceptance denominators. Auxiliary pairs enter only the meaning-invariance gate.
qualification_rule: Both isolated passes must independently satisfy every accuracy, error-rate, protected-predicate, and zero-call-failure gate.
uncertainty_rule: Report pass-specific Wilson 95 percent intervals and class-wise counts; zero observed errors does not establish zero population error.
retry_policy: At most the arm manifest's bounded transport retry; never retry a usable or inconvenient judgment.
hard_stop: Run exactly two isolated passes once. Retain a failed result without prompt, reference, threshold, or denominator changes. Physical/reference collection continues regardless.
activation_condition: Both passes qualify and the governed result manifest is committed before semantic study scoring; P/R method and resource parity require a separate freeze.
